889	def stage_clip(ctx: Ctx, path: Path, src_in: float, dur: float, fps: int) -> Path:
890	    """Cut an overlay clip's used window to a clean, video-only, constant-fps lossless file (cached).
891	
892	    Feeding pack clips straight in with -ss/-t made ffmpeg 9 hang at the very end of the final pass for some
893	    files (24 fps clips with a non-zero start time, e.g. 'Patrick Stewart Epic Facepalm', the anime speed
894	    lines): every frame got written, the mp4 was never finalised. Pre-cut inputs avoid it, and the final pass
895	    gets cheaper. ProRes/alpha sources stay ProRes 4444 so their alpha survives."""
896	    import hashlib as _h
897	    st = path.stat()
898	    key = _h.sha1(f"{path}|{st.st_mtime_ns}|{st.st_size}|{src_in:.3f}|{dur:.3f}|{fps}".encode()).hexdigest()[:12]
899	    alpha = path.suffix.lower() == ".mov"
900	    out = ctx.work / "stage" / f"clip_{key}.{'mov' if alpha else 'mkv'}"
901	    if not out.exists():
902	        out.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
903	        codec = ["-c:v", "prores_ks", "-profile:v", "4444", "-pix_fmt", "yuva444p10le"] if alpha \
904	            else ["-c:v", "ffv1", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p"]
905	        tmp = out.with_name(out.stem + ".tmp" + out.suffix)
906	        run_ff(["-ss", f"{src_in:.3f}", "-t", f"{dur:.3f}", "-i", path, "-an", "-sn", "-dn",
907	                "-vf", f"fps={fps},setpts=PTS-STARTPTS", *codec, tmp], ctx.work, ctx.log)
908	        os.replace(tmp, out)
909	    return out

912	def build_overlays(ctx: Ctx, spans) -> tuple[list[list], list[str], str, list[dict]]:
913	    W, H, FPS = ctx.W, ctx.H, ctx.FPS
914	    inputs, chains, overlay_audio = [], [], []
915	    cur = "[0:v]"
916	    for k, ev in enumerate(ctx.edl.get("overlays", [])):
917	        label = f"overlay[{k}] {ev.get('asset') or ev.get('file')}"
918	        at = resolve_time(ev, spans, ctx.warnings, label)
919	        if at is None:
920	            continue
921	        if ev.get("template"):
922	            ev = {**ev, "file": str(motion_file(ctx, ev)), "placement": ev.get("placement", "fullscreen"),
923	                  "key_mode": "alpha", "audio": False}
924	            ev.setdefault("dur", motion_duration(ev["template"], ev.get("vars")))
925	        a = ctx.asset(ev["asset"]) if ev.get("asset") else {}
926	        path = ctx.media_path(ev)
927	        typ = ev["type"]
928	        mode = ev.get("key_mode", a.get("key_mode"))
929	        if mode == "alpha" and path.suffix.lower() == ".webm":
930	            ctx.warnings.append(f"{label}: webm side-data alpha can't be decoded by this ffmpeg build; "
931	                                "convert once with `mcs prep-alpha` or use a ProRes/PNG version")
932	        src_in = ev.get("in", a.get("use_in") or 0.0)
933	        if typ == "image":
934	            dur = ev.get("dur", 1.2)
935	        else:
936	            dur = ev.get("dur") or ((ev.get("out") or a.get("use_out") or a.get("duration_s") or 2.0) - src_in)
937	        if typ == "transition":
938	            cover = ev.get("cover_s", dur / 2)
939	            at = max(0.0, at - cover)
940	        if typ == "image":
941	            # Looped-image *inputs* stall ffmpeg 9's scheduler once they hit EOF before the main stream,
942	            # so stills/GIFs come in through the movie= source filter instead (staged to a short
943	            # relative path to dodge filtergraph escaping of Windows paths).
944	            stage = ctx.work / "stage"
945	            stage.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
946	            staged = stage / f"img{k:03d}{path.suffix.lower()}"
947	            if not staged.exists() or staged.stat().st_size != path.stat().st_size:
948	                shutil.copyfile(path, staged)
949	            src_pad = f"movie=stage/{staged.name}:loop=0,setpts=N/{FPS}/TB,trim=duration={dur:.3f},"
950	        else:
951	            n = len(inputs) + 1
952	            inputs.append(["-i", stage_clip(ctx, path, src_in, dur, FPS)])
953	            src_pad = f"[{n}:v]setpts=PTS-STARTPTS,"
954	        placement = ev.get("placement") or a.get("placement") or "overlay_center"
955	        if typ == "transition" or placement == "fullscreen":
956	            size = f"scale={W}:{H}"
957	            x, y = "0", "0"
958	        else:
959	            sc = ev.get("scale", 0.45 if typ != "image" else 0.3)
960	            hpx = int(H * sc) // 2 * 2
961	            if ev.get("anim", "pop" if typ == "image" else None) == "pop":
962	                size = f"scale=w=-2:h='trunc({hpx}*{POP}/2)*2':eval=frame"
963	            else:
964	                size = f"scale=-2:{hpx}"
965	            cx, cy = ev.get("x", 0.5), ev.get("y", 0.5)
966	            x = f"{W * cx:.1f}-overlay_w/2"
967	            y = f"{H * cy:.1f}-overlay_h/2"
968	        flip = ",hflip" if ev.get("flip") else ""
969	        rot = f",rotate={ev['rotate']}*PI/180:c=none:ow=rotw(iw):oh=roth(ih)" if ev.get("rotate") else ""
970	        kf = key_filter(mode, a.get("key_color") if ev.get("key_color") is None else ev["key_color"], ev)
971	        op = f",colorchannelmixer=aa={ev['opacity']}" if "opacity" in ev else ""
972	        chains.append(f"{src_pad}fps={FPS},{kf},{size}{flip}{rot}{op},"
973	                      f"setpts=PTS+{at:.4f}/TB[ov{k}]")
974	        nxt = f"[v{k}]"
975	        chains.append(f"{cur}[ov{k}]overlay=x='{x}':y='{y}':enable='between(t,{at:.4f},{at + dur:.4f})':"
976	                      f"eof_action=pass{nxt}")
977	        cur = nxt
978	        if typ != "image" and ev.get("audio", True) and a.get("has_audio", 1):
979	            vol = ctx.matched_db(a, ctx.style["audio"]["mix"]["overlay_rel_db"],
980	                                 ctx.style["audio"]["sfx_db"] + (a.get("volume_db") or 0)) + ev.get("volume_db", 0)
981	            overlay_audio.append({"path": path, "at": at, "in": src_in, "dur": dur, "vol": vol})
982	    cur = avatar_overlays(ctx, spans, cur, chains)
983	    wm = ctx.edl.get("watermark") or {}
984	    if wm.get("image"):                                  # channel logo bug, top-right, whole video
985	        src = next((c for c in (STUDIO / wm["image"], Path(wm["image"])) if c.is_file()), None)
986	        if src:
987	            stage = ctx.work / "stage"
988	            stage.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
989	            staged = stage / f"wm{src.suffix.lower()}"
990	            shutil.copyfile(src, staged)
991	            hpx = int(H * wm.get("size", 0.085 if ctx.format != "vertical" else 0.05)) // 2 * 2
992	            # ONE still frame held by overlay's eof_action=repeat: an endless looped source deadlocks ffmpeg 9's
993	            # scheduler once the other (-t limited) overlay inputs hit EOF
994	            chains.append(f"movie=stage/{staged.name},format=rgba,scale=-2:{hpx},"
995	                          f"colorchannelmixer=aa={wm.get('opacity', 0.8)}[wm]")
996	            m = int(H * 0.025)
997	            chains.append(f"{cur}[wm]overlay=x=W-overlay_w-{m}:y={m}:eof_action=repeat:repeatlast=1[vwm]")
998	            cur = "[vwm]"
999	        else:
1000	            ctx.warnings.append(f"watermark image not found: {wm['image']}")
1001	    return inputs, chains, cur, overlay_audio

1	"""Local web UI backend:  uv run mcs ui   ->  http://127.0.0.1:8765
2	
3	Binds to localhost only. Serves the static app in studio/ui, a JSON API over the catalog and projects,
4	media from the Editing Pack / catalog thumbnails / project folders, and runs pipeline stages as
5	background jobs with streamed logs.
6	"""
7	from __future__ import annotations
8	
9	import json
10	import os
11	import re
12	import shutil
13	import sqlite3
14	import subprocess
15	import sys
16	import threading
17	import time
18	import uuid
19	from datetime import datetime
20	from pathlib import Path
21	
22	from fastapi import FastAPI, File, Form, HTTPException, Query, UploadFile
23	from fastapi.responses import FileResponse, JSONResponse
24	from fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles
25	from pydantic import BaseModel
26	
27	from . import assets as A
28	from .edl import EDLError, build_spans, resolve_time, seg_duration, validate
29	from .paths import ASSETS_DB, CATALOG, PACK, PROJECTS, ROOT, STUDIO, STYLE, TAXONOMY
30	
31	UI = STUDIO / "ui"
32	app = FastAPI(title="MC Studio")
33	
34	
35	@app.middleware("http")
36	async def no_cache_ui(request, call_next):
37	    resp = await call_next(request)
38	    if not request.url.path.startswith(("/media/", "/api/")):
39	        resp.headers["Cache-Control"] = "no-cache"   # always revalidate the app shell after edits
40	    return resp
41	
42	
43	# ------------------------------------------------------------------ helpers
44	def inside(base: Path, rel: str) -> Path:
45	    p = (base / rel).resolve()
46	    if base.resolve() not in p.parents and p != base.resolve():
47	        raise HTTPException(403, "path escapes base")
48	    if not p.exists():
49	        raise HTTPException(404, f"not found: {rel}")
50	    return p
51	
52	
53	def read_json(p: Path, default=None):
54	    try:
55	        return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
56	    except (OSError, ValueError):
57	        return default
58	
59	
60	def db() -> sqlite3.Connection:
61	    return A.connect()   # Row factory + busy timeout + adds the `favorite` column to DBs built by older merges
62	
63	
64	# ------------------------------------------------------------------ media
65	@app.get("/media/pack/{rel:path}")
66	def media_pack(rel: str):
67	    return FileResponse(inside(PACK, rel))
68	
69	
70	@app.get("/media/lib/{root}/{rel:path}")
71	def media_lib(root: str, rel: str):
72	    if root not in ("Editing Pack", "Stock Library"):
73	        raise HTTPException(403)
74	    return FileResponse(inside(ROOT / root, rel))
75	
76	
77	@app.get("/media/studio/{rel:path}")
78	def media_studio(rel: str):
79	    if not rel.startswith(("brand/", "motion/")):
80	        raise HTTPException(403)
81	    return FileResponse(inside(STUDIO, rel))
82	
83	
84	@app.get("/media/catalog/{rel:path}")
85	def media_catalog(rel: str):
86	    return FileResponse(inside(CATALOG, rel))
87	
88	
89	@app.get("/media/project/{slug}/{rel:path}")
90	def media_project(slug: str, rel: str):
91	    return FileResponse(inside(PROJECTS / slug, rel))
92	
93	
94	@app.get("/media/abs")
95	def media_abs(path: str):
96	    """Raw recordings referenced by absolute path in project.json (only those)."""
97	    allowed = set()
98	    for pj in PROJECTS.glob("*/project.json"):
99	        for s in (read_json(pj, {}).get("sources") or {}).values():
100	            if isinstance(s, dict) and s.get("file"):
101	                f = Path(s["file"])
102	                allowed.add(str((f if f.is_absolute() else pj.parent / f).resolve()))
103	    p = str(Path(path).resolve())
104	    if p not in allowed:
105	        raise HTTPException(403, "not a project source")
106	    return FileResponse(p)
107	
108	
109	# ------------------------------------------------------------------ catalog
110	@app.get("/api/taxonomy")
111	def taxonomy():
112	    return read_json(TAXONOMY)
113	
114	
115	@app.get("/api/style")
116	def style():
117	    return read_json(STYLE)
118	
119	
120	@app.get("/api/stats")
121	def stats():
122	    s = A.stats()
123	    con = db()
124	    s["usage"] = [dict(r) for r in con.execute(
125	        "SELECT asset_id, COUNT(*) n FROM usage GROUP BY asset_id ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 15")]
126	    return s
127	
128	
129	def row_out(r: sqlite3.Row) -> dict:
130	    d = A.as_dict(r)
131	    d.pop("abs_path", None)
132	    return d
133	
134	
135	@app.get("/api/assets")
136	def list_assets(q: str = "", moment: list[str] = Query(default=[]), category: list[str] = Query(default=[]),
137	                role: list[str] = Query(default=[]), rating: list[str] = Query(default=[]),
138	                risk: list[str] = Query(default=[]), kind: str = "", key_mode: str = "", root: str = "",
139	                ranked: bool = False, project: str = "", limit: int = 60, offset: int = 0,
140	                favorites: bool = False):
141	    if ranked and (moment or q or role):
142	        # same scorer the planner uses
143	        res = A.find(A.Query(moments=moment, roles=role, categories=category, text=q or None,
144	                             max_rating="explicit", max_risk="high", project=project or None, limit=limit,
145	                             favorites_only=favorites))
146	        for r in res:
147	            r.pop("abs_path", None)
148	        return {"total": len(res), "items": res}
149	    where, args = ["1=1"], []
150	    if q:
151	        terms = [t for t in "".join(c if c.isalnum() else " " for c in q).split() if t]
152	        if terms:
153	            ids = [r[0] for r in db().execute("SELECT id FROM assets_fts WHERE assets_fts MATCH ?",
154	                                              (" ".join(f'"{t}"*' for t in terms),))]
155	            where.append(f"id IN ({','.join('?' * len(ids))})" if ids else "0")
156	            args += ids
157	    for col, vals in (("category", category), ("content_rating", rating), ("copyright_risk", risk)):
158	        if vals:
159	            # untagged assets (no rating yet) stay visible instead of silently disappearing
160	            extra = " OR content_rating IS NULL" if col == "content_rating" else ""
161	            where.append(f"({col} IN ({','.join('?' * len(vals))}){extra})")
162	            args += vals
163	    for m in moment:
164	        where.append("moments LIKE ?")
165	        args.append(f'%"{m}"%')
166	    for ro in role:
167	        where.append("roles LIKE ?")
168	        args.append(f'%"{ro}"%')
169	    if kind:
170	        where.append("kind = ?")
171	        args.append(kind)
172	    if root:
173	        where.append("root = ?")
174	        args.append(root)
175	    if key_mode:
176	        where.append("key_mode = ?")
177	        args.append(key_mode)
178	    if favorites:
179	        where.append("favorite = 1")
180	    con = db()
181	    w = " AND ".join(where)
182	    total = con.execute(f"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assets WHERE {w}", args).fetchone()[0]
183	    rows = con.execute(f"SELECT * FROM assets WHERE {w} ORDER BY category, title LIMIT ? OFFSET ?",
184	                       args + [limit, offset]).fetchall()
185	    return {"total": total, "items": [row_out(r) for r in rows]}
186

188	@app.get("/api/assets/{aid}")
189	def get_asset(aid: str):
190	    try:
191	        d = A.get(aid)
192	    except KeyError:
193	        raise HTTPException(404) from None
194	    d.pop("abs_path", None)
195	    d["used_in"] = [dict(r) for r in db().execute(
196	        "SELECT project, COUNT(*) n FROM usage WHERE asset_id=? GROUP BY project", (aid,))]

200	class FavoriteBody(BaseModel):
201	    on: bool

204	@app.post("/api/assets/{aid}/favorite")
205	def favorite_asset(aid: str, body: FavoriteBody):
206	    try:
207	        d = A.set_favorite(aid, body.on)   # favorites.json + DB row, no rebuild
208	    except KeyError:

211	
212	
213	class AssetPatch(BaseModel):
214	    fields: dict
215	
216	
217	EDITABLE = {"description", "moments", "roles", "tags", "quote", "mood", "energy", "content_rating",
218	            "copyright_risk", "placement", "key_mode", "use_window", "volume_db", "frequency", "notes"}
219	
220	
221	@app.patch("/api/assets/{aid}")
222	def patch_asset(aid: str, body: AssetPatch):
223	    bad = set(body.fields) - EDITABLE
224	    if bad:
225	        raise HTTPException(400, f"not editable: {sorted(bad)}")
226	    path = CATALOG / "overrides.json"
227	    ov = read_json(path, {})
228	    ov.setdefault(aid, {}).update(body.fields)
229	    path.write_text(json.dumps(ov, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8")
230	    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(CATALOG / "merge_catalog.py")], capture_output=True, text=True)
231	    if r.returncode != 0:
232	        raise HTTPException(500, r.stderr[-2000:])
233	    return get_asset(aid)
234	
235	
236	# ------------------------------------------------------------------ projects
237	def project_status(p: Path) -> dict:
238	    w = p / "work"
239	    outs = sorted((p / "out").glob("*.mp4"), key=lambda f: f.stat().st_mtime, reverse=True) if (p / "out").exists() else []
240	    edl = read_json(p / "edit.json")
241	    pj = read_json(p / "project.json", {})
242	    return {
243	        "slug": p.name, "title": pj.get("title", p.name), "duration_s": pj.get("duration_s"),
244	        "transcribed": (w / "transcript.json").exists(), "analyzed": (w / "signals.json").exists(),
245	        "has_edit": edl is not None, "segments": len(edl["segments"]) if edl else 0,
246	        "outputs": [{"name": f.name, "size": f.stat().st_size,
247	                     "mtime": datetime.fromtimestamp(f.stat().st_mtime).isoformat(timespec="seconds")} for f in outs],
248	        "modified": datetime.fromtimestamp(max((f.stat().st_mtime for f in p.glob("*.json")), default=p.stat().st_mtime)).isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
249	        "job": next((j.public() for j in reversed(JOBS.values()) if j.slug == p.name and j.status == "running"), None),
250	        "kind": pj.get("kind", "episode"), "parent": pj.get("parent"), "context": pj.get("context", ""),
251	        "generator": (edl or {}).get("generator"), "format": (edl or {}).get("format", "landscape"),
252	        "shorts": sorted(c.name for c in PROJECTS.glob(f"{p.name}--short-*") if (c / "edit.json").exists()),
253	    }
254	
255	
256	@app.get("/api/projects")
257	def projects():
258	    out = [project_status(p) for p in PROJECTS.iterdir() if (p / "project.json").exists()]
259	    return sorted(out, key=lambda x: x["modified"], reverse=True)

279	    from .ingest import new_project as np_

299	        if game else None,

304	        "sheets": sorted(f"work/sheets/{f.name}" for f in (w / "sheets").glob("*.jpg")) if (w / "sheets").exists() else [],
305	        "report": read_json(w / "full" / "render_report.json") or read_json(w / "preview" / "render_report.json"),

309	@app.get("/api/projects/{slug}/timeline")
310	def timeline(slug: str):
311	    """EDL resolved into output time, grouped by track, for the timeline view."""
312	    p = inside(PROJECTS, slug)
313	    edl = read_json(p / "edit.json")
314	    if not edl:
315	        return {"duration": 0, "tracks": {}, "warnings": []}
316	    warnings: list[str] = []

318	    def lookup(i):

320	            return A.get(i)

322	            warnings.append(f"unknown asset {i}")
323	            return None
324	    try:
325	        validate(edl)
326	        spans = build_spans(edl, lookup)
327	    except (EDLError, KeyError, TypeError) as e:
328	        return {"duration": 0, "tracks": {}, "warnings": [f"EDL error: {e}"]}
329	    tracks: dict[str, list] = {"segments": [], "overlays": [], "text": [], "sfx": [], "music": [], "bleeps": [],
330	                               "zooms": []}
331	    t = 0.0
332	    for i, s in enumerate(edl["segments"]):
333	        d = seg_duration(s, lookup)
334	        tracks["segments"].append({"i": i, "start": t, "end": t + d, "type": s.get("type", "source"),
335	                                   "label": s.get("id") or s.get("asset") or f"seg{i}", "src_in": s.get("in"),
336	                                   "src_out": s.get("out"), "speed": s.get("speed", 1), "effects": s.get("effects", []),
337	                                   "mode": s.get("mode") or edl.get("mode", "funny")})
338	        for z in s.get("zoom", []) + [dict(x, shake=True) for x in s.get("shake", [])]:
339	            a = z["at"] if "at" in z else (z["src_at"] - s["in"]) / s.get("speed", 1)
340	            dz = z.get("dur") or (z.get("in", 0.12) + z.get("hold", 0.6) + z.get("out", 0.18))
341	            tracks["zooms"].append({"start": t + a, "end": t + min(a + dz, d),
342	                                    "label": "shake" if z.get("shake") else f"x{z.get('to', 1.3)}"})
343	        t += d
344	    total = t
345	
346	    def add(track, evs, default_dur, label_fn):
347	        for k, ev in enumerate(evs):
348	            at = resolve_time(ev, spans, warnings, f"{track}[{k}]") if ("at" in ev or "src_at" in ev) else 0.0
349	            if at is None:
350	                continue
351	            a = lookup(ev["asset"]) if ev.get("asset") else None
352	            dur = ev.get("dur") or (ev.get("until", total) - at if track == "music" else None) \
353	                or (a.get("tail_s") or a.get("duration_s") if a else None) or default_dur
354	            tracks[track].append({"k": k, "start": at, "end": min(total, at + dur), "label": label_fn(ev, a),
355	                                  "asset": ev.get("asset"), "thumb": a.get("thumb") if a else None})
356	    add("overlays", edl.get("overlays", []), 1.5, lambda e, a: f"{e['type']}: {(a or {}).get('title') or e.get('file')}")
357	    add("text", edl.get("text", []), 1.2, lambda e, a: e.get("text", ""))
358	    add("sfx", edl.get("audio", {}).get("sfx", []), 1.0, lambda e, a: (a or {}).get("title") or e.get("asset"))
359	    add("music", edl.get("audio", {}).get("music", []), total, lambda e, a: (a or {}).get("title") or e.get("asset"))
360	    add("bleeps", edl.get("audio", {}).get("bleeps", []), 0.4, lambda e, a: "bleep")
361	    return {"duration": total, "tracks": tracks, "warnings": warnings, "format": edl.get("format", "landscape")}

385	class Job:
386	    def __init__(self, slug: str, stage: str, cmd: list[str], cwd: Path):
387	        self.id = uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]
388	        self.slug, self.stage, self.cmd, self.cwd = slug, stage, cmd, cwd
389	        self.status = "running"
390	        self.lines: list[str] = []
391	        self.started = time.time()
392	        self.ended: float | None = None
393	        self.rc: int | None = None
394	        self.proc: subprocess.Popen | None = None
395	        self.result: dict | None = None     # set from a "@@RESULT {json}" line printed by the command
396	        threading.Thread(target=self._run, daemon=True).start()
397	
398	    def _run(self):
399	        env = dict(os.environ, PYTHONUNBUFFERED="1", PYTHONIOENCODING="utf-8")
400	        try:
401	            self.proc = subprocess.Popen(self.cmd, cwd=self.cwd, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
402	                                         text=True, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace", env=env)
403	            for line in self.proc.stdout:
404	                if line.startswith("@@RESULT "):
405	                    try:
406	                        self.result = json.loads(line[9:])
407	                    except ValueError:
408	                        pass
409	                    continue
410	                self.lines.append(line.rstrip())
411	                if len(self.lines) > 4000:
412	                    del self.lines[:1000]
413	            self.rc = self.proc.wait()
414	            self.status = "done" if self.rc == 0 else "failed"
415	        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
416	            self.lines.append(f"!! {e}")
417	            self.status = "failed"
418	        self.ended = time.time()
419	
420	    def public(self, tail: int = 200) -> dict:
421	        return {"id": self.id, "slug": self.slug, "stage": self.stage, "status": self.status, "rc": self.rc,
422	                "started": self.started, "elapsed": round((self.ended or time.time()) - self.started, 1),
423	                "log": self.lines[-tail:], "result": self.result}

645	def _motion_template_out(t: dict) -> dict:
646	    from . import motion as M
647	    from . import motion_previews as MP
648	    name = t["name"]
649	    try:
650	        resolved = M.resolve_vars(name)
651	    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - a half-written template.json shouldn't break the page
652	        resolved = {}
653	    vars_out = []
654	    for key, spec in (t.get("vars") or {}).items():
655	        if key == "opaque":                       # set by the opaque flag, not a form field
656	            continue
657	        label, options = spec.get("label", key), spec.get("options") or spec.get("enum")
658	        if not options:   # enum-like labels: "Block style: color | stone | dirt"
659	            mm = re.fullmatch(r"(.*?):\s*([\w-]+(?:\s*\|\s*[\w-]+)+)\s*", label)
660	            if mm:
661	                label, options = mm.group(1).strip(), [o.strip() for o in mm.group(2).split("|")]
662	        vars_out.append({"key": key, "type": spec.get("type", "string"), "label": label,
663	                         "default": resolved.get(key, spec.get("default")), "brand": spec.get("brand"),
664	                         "options": options, "min": spec.get("min"),
665	                         "max": spec.get("max"), "step": spec.get("step"), "help": spec.get("help")})
666	    p = MP.paths(name)
667	    return {"name": name, "description": t.get("description", ""), "kind": t.get("kind", "overlay"),
668	            "duration": t.get("duration"), "stretchable": bool(t.get("stretchable")),
669	            "min_duration": t.get("min_duration"), "cut_at": t.get("cut_at"),
670	            "orientations": t.get("orientations", ["landscape", "vertical"]),
671	            "opaque_ok": "opaque" in (t.get("vars") or {}), "vars": vars_out,
672	            "preview_mp4": MP.rel_url(p["mp4"]) if p["mp4"].exists() else None,
673	            "poster": MP.rel_url(p["jpg"]) if p["jpg"].exists() else None,

1	"""mcs - Minecraft editing studio CLI.  Run `uv run mcs <command> -h` (from studio/) for details.
2	
3	Assembly line:
4	  mcs new <slug> --game rec.mkv [--mic mic.wav]   create project
5	  mcs transcribe <slug>                           word-level transcript (source time)
6	  mcs analyze <slug>                              loudness/scene signals + frame sheets
7	  mcs scaffold <slug>                             first-pass edit.json (dead air removed)
8	  (planner edits edit.json: zooms, SFX, memes, greenscreens, text, bleeps, music)
9	  mcs check <slug>                                validate + timeline digest + policy warnings
10	  mcs render <slug> [--preview]                   ffmpeg render -> out/<slug>.mp4
11	Library:
12	  mcs assets find|show|stats                      query the editing-pack database
13	  mcs assets fav|unfav <ids...> / favs            star assets so the auto-editor prefers them
14	  mcs frames <slug> --from S --to E               frame sheet for a moment
15	  mcs ui                                          local web UI at http://127.0.0.1:8765
16	One click:
17	  mcs make <slug> --game rec.mkv [--mic m.wav] [--facecam cam.mp4] --title "..." --context "..."
18	  mcs auto <slug> [--final] [--shorts 3]          transcribe -> analyze -> autoplan -> render -> shorts
19	  mcs autoplan <slug> [--mode funny]              heuristic creative pass (no LLM needed)
20	  mcs engage <slug>                               add attention zooms to an existing edit
21	  mcs shorts <slug> [--count 3] [--render]        cut 9:16 shorts from the edit
22	Libraries:
23	  mcs library add|scan|status                     your Stock Library (B-roll, stock, memes)
24	  mcs motion list|render <template> --var k=v     channel motion-graphics templates (HyperFrames)
25	  mcs avatar build|preview                        narrator avatar from brand/avatar/skin.png
26	"""

81	def cmd_check(a):
82	    from . import assets as A
83	    from .edl import build_spans, load, resolve_time, total_duration
84	    from .paths import STYLE, project_dir
85	    proj = project_dir(a.slug)
86	    edl = load(proj / "edit.json")
87	    style = json.loads(STYLE.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
88	    pace = style["pacing"]
89	    warnings, errors = [], []
90	
91	    def lookup(i):
92	        try:
93	            return A.get(i)
94	        except KeyError:
95	            errors.append(f"unknown asset {i}")
96	            return None
97	    spans = build_spans(edl, lookup)
98	    total = total_duration(edl, lookup)
99	    rating_rank = {"clean": 0, "mild": 1, "explicit": 2, "banned": 3}
100	    max_default = rating_rank[edl.get("max_rating", pace["default_max_rating"])]
101	    first_max = rating_rank[pace["first_15s_max_rating"]]
102	    timeline = []
103	
104	    def check_asset(aid, at, what, used_for=None):
105	        x = lookup(aid)
106	        if not x:
107	            return
108	        r = rating_rank.get(x.get("content_rating") or "explicit", 2)
109	        if r >= 3:
110	            errors.append(f"{what}: {aid} is BANNED content")
111	        elif at is not None and at < 15 and r > first_max:
112	            warnings.append(f"{what}: {aid} ({x['content_rating']}) in first 15s hurts monetization")
113	        elif r > max_default:
114	            warnings.append(f"{what}: {aid} rated {x['content_rating']} above the video's max_rating")
115	        if x.get("copyright_risk") == "high" and used_for is not None:
116	            limit = 10.0 if x["category"] == "music" else 6.0
117	            if used_for > limit:
118	                warnings.append(f"{what}: {aid} is copyrighted and plays {used_for:.0f}s - keep quick clips under "
119	                                f"~{limit:.0f}s (transformative use); copyrighted music beds are the usual Content ID claim")
120	        timeline.append((at if at is not None else -1, what, aid))
121	
122	    t = 0.0
123	    for i, s in enumerate(edl["segments"]):
124	        if s.get("asset"):
125	            check_asset(s["asset"], t, f"segment {s.get('id', i)} cutaway", spans[i].out_end - spans[i].out_start)
126	        t = spans[i].out_end + s.get("freeze_end", 0.0)
127	    groups = [("overlay", edl.get("overlays", [])), ("sfx", edl.get("audio", {}).get("sfx", [])),
128	              ("music", edl.get("audio", {}).get("music", []))]
129	    counts = {}
130	    for name, evs in groups:
131	        counts[name] = len(evs)
132	        for k, ev in enumerate(evs):
133	            at = resolve_time(ev, spans, warnings, f"{name}[{k}]") if ("at" in ev or "src_at" in ev or "seg" in ev) else 0.0
134	            if ev.get("asset"):
135	                x = lookup(ev["asset"]) or {}
136	                if name == "music":
137	                    used = (ev.get("until", total) - (at or 0))
138	                else:
139	                    used = ev.get("dur") or ((x.get("tail_s") or x.get("duration_s") or 0) - (ev.get("in") or 0))
140	                check_asset(ev["asset"], at, f"{name}[{k}]", used)
141	    for k, ev in enumerate(edl.get("text", [])):
142	        at = resolve_time(ev, spans, warnings, f"text[{k}]")
143	        timeline.append((at if at is not None else -1, f"text[{k}]", ev.get("text")))
144	    mins = max(total / 60, 1e-6)
145	    zooms = sum(len([z for z in s.get("zoom", []) if not z.get("auto")]) for s in edl["segments"])
146	    auto_zooms = sum(len([z for z in s.get("zoom", []) if z.get("auto")]) for s in edl["segments"])
147	    cutaways = sum(1 for s in edl["segments"] if s.get("type") == "cutaway")
148	    density = {
149	        "sfx_per_minute": (counts["sfx"] / mins, pace["sfx_per_minute"]),
150	        "zooms_per_minute": (zooms / mins, pace["zooms_per_minute"]),
151	        "meme_cutaways_per_minute": (cutaways / mins, pace["meme_cutaways_per_minute"]),
152	        "greenscreens_per_minute": (sum(1 for o in edl.get("overlays", []) if o["type"] == "greenscreen") / mins,
153	                                    pace["greenscreens_per_minute"]),
154	    }
155	    src_segs = [s for s in edl["segments"] if s.get("type", "source") == "source"]
156	    avg_seg = sum((s["out"] - s["in"]) / s.get("speed", 1) for s in src_segs) / max(len(src_segs), 1)
157	    print(f"duration {total:.1f}s ({total / 60:.1f} min), {len(edl['segments'])} segments "
158	          f"(avg source shot {avg_seg:.1f}s), {cutaways} cutaways, {auto_zooms / mins:.1f} engagement zooms/min")
159	    for k, (v, (lo, hi)) in density.items():
160	        flag = "" if lo <= v <= hi else ("  <- LOW" if v < lo else "  <- HIGH")
161	        print(f"  {k:<26} {v:5.1f}  (target {lo}-{hi}){flag}")
162	    if a.timeline:
163	        for at, what, aid in sorted(timeline, key=lambda x: x[0]):
164	            m, s = divmod(max(at, 0), 60)
165	            print(f"  {int(m):02d}:{s:05.2f}  {what:<22} {aid}")
166	    for w in warnings:
167	        print("WARN ", w)
168	    for e in errors:
169	        print("ERROR", e)
170	    sys.exit(1 if errors else 0)

"""The one-click assembly line: footage + mic (+ title/context) in, finished video + shorts out."""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import time

from .paths import project_dir


def step(name: str):
    print(f"\n=== {name} ===", flush=True)
    return time.time()


def run_auto(slug: str, mode: str | None = None, final: bool = False, shorts: int = 3,
             model: str = "large-v3-turbo", replan: bool = False) -> None:
    proj = project_dir(slug)
    t0 = time.time()
    if not (proj / "work" / "transcript.json").exists():
        step("transcribe")
        from .transcribe import transcribe
        transcribe(slug, model)
    if not (proj / "work" / "signals.json").exists():
        step("analyze")
        from .analyze import analyze
        analyze(slug)
    edl_p = proj / "edit.json"
    hand_made = edl_p.exists() and json.loads(edl_p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")).get("generator") != "autoplan"
    if not edl_p.exists() or replan or not hand_made:
        step("autoplan")
        from .autoplan import autoplan
        autoplan(slug, mode)
    else:
        print("\n(keeping the existing hand-made edit.json - pass --replan to overwrite)")
    step("render " + ("final" if final else "preview"))
    from .render import render
    out = render(slug, preview=not final, record=final)
    made = []
    if shorts:
        step(f"shorts x{shorts}")
        from .shorts import make_shorts
        made = make_shorts(slug, shorts, render=True, preview=not final)
    print(f"\n✔ done in {time.time() - t0:.0f}s\n  video : {out}")
    for s in made:
        print(f"  short : projects/{s}/out/")

"""Feature settings: one central on/off switchboard for everything the auto-editor and renderer do.

    studio/settings.json                 global settings (only keys that differ from the defaults are needed)
    projects/<slug>/settings.json        per-episode overrides (only changed keys; null = inherit)

    load(slug)  ->  defaults <- settings.json <- parent episode overrides (for shorts) <- episode overrides

SCHEMA is the single source of truth: it defines every setting's default, label, help text, type and where it
applies ("plan" = autoplan/engage/shorts/scaffold decide not to place it, "render" = the renderer also strips it
from an EXISTING edit.json, "both"). The UI renders the schema generically, so adding a setting = one entry here
plus the line of code that reads it.

Render-time switches are applied by `apply_render(edl, S, ...)` when the renderer loads an EDL: the edit.json on
disk is never modified, so turning a switch back on restores the original edit.

    return {"key": key, "label": label, "type": "bool", "default": default, "help": help_, "applies": applies, **kw}


def _n(key, label, default, help_, applies, lo, hi, step, unit="", **kw):
    return {"key": key, "label": label, "type": "number", "default": default, "help": help_, "applies": applies,
            "min": lo, "max": hi, "step": step, "unit": unit, **kw}


def _off(key, label, help_, applies, options, **kw):
    """Multi-select stored as the list of DISABLED items (new items added later default to allowed)."""
    return {"key": key, "label": label, "type": "multi", "invert": True, "default": [], "help": help_,

def defaults() -> dict:
    return {sec["key"]: {s["key"]: copy.deepcopy(s["default"]) for s in sec["settings"]} for sec in SCHEMA}


def _spec(section: str, key: str) -> dict | None:
    sec = next((s for s in SCHEMA if s["key"] == section), None)
    return next((s for s in sec["settings"] if s["key"] == key), None) if sec else None


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ dynamic option lists
def _read(p: Path, default=None):
    try:
        return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except (OSError, ValueError):
        return default


def options(kind: str) -> list[dict]:
    if kind.startswith("looks"):
        looks = _read(STUDIO / "looks.json", {})
        out = [{"value": k, "label": v.get("label", k), "help": v.get("about", "")}
               for k, v in looks.items() if not k.startswith("_")]
        return ([{"value": "", "label": "Inherit (style.json)"}] if kind.endswith("+inherit") else []) + out
    if kind == "modes":
        modes = _read(STUDIO / "modes.json", {})
        return [{"value": k, "label": v.get("label", k), "color": v.get("color")}
                for k, v in modes.items() if not k.startswith("_") and k != "funny"]   # funny = the fallback
    if kind == "templates":
        out = []
        tdir = STUDIO / "motion" / "templates"
        for d in sorted(tdir.iterdir()) if tdir.exists() else []:
            t = _read(d / "template.json")
            if t is not None:
                out.append({"value": d.name, "label": d.name, "help": t.get("description", ""),
                            "poster": f"/media/studio/motion/previews/{d.name}.jpg"
                            if (STUDIO / "motion" / "previews" / f"{d.name}.jpg").exists() else None})
        return out
    return []


def schema() -> dict:
    """SCHEMA with dynamic option lists resolved, plus the defaults (for the UI)."""
    secs = copy.deepcopy(SCHEMA)
    for sec in secs:
        for s in sec["settings"]:
            s["path"] = f"{sec['key']}.{s['key']}"
            if isinstance(s.get("options"), str):
                s["options"] = options(s["options"])
            elif isinstance(s.get("options"), list) and s["options"] and isinstance(s["options"][0], str):
                s["options"] = [{"value": o, "label": o.replace("_", " ")} for o in s["options"]]
    return {"sections": secs, "defaults": defaults()}


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ load / save
def deep_merge(a: dict, b: dict) -> dict:
    out = dict(a)
    for k, v in (b or {}).items():
        if v is None:                                      # null = inherit
            continue
        out[k] = deep_merge(out[k], v) if isinstance(v, dict) and isinstance(out.get(k), dict) else v
    return out


def project_file(slug: str) -> Path:
    return PROJECTS / slug / "settings.json"


def read_global() -> dict:
    return _read(GLOBAL_FILE, {}) or {}


def read_project(slug: str) -> dict:
    return _read(project_file(slug), {}) or {}


def global_settings() -> dict:
    return deep_merge(defaults(), read_global())


def load(slug: str | None = None) -> dict:
    S = global_settings()
    if slug:
        pj = _read(PROJECTS / slug / "project.json", {}) or {}
        parent = pj.get("parent")
        if parent and parent != slug:                    # shorts inherit their episode's overrides
            S = deep_merge(S, read_project(parent))
        S = deep_merge(S, read_project(slug))
    return S


def coerce(path: str, value):
    """Validate / convert one value against the schema. Raises ValueError."""
    section, _, key = path.partition(".")
    spec = _spec(section, key)
    if not spec:
        raise ValueError(f"unknown setting {path!r}")
    if value is None:
        return None
    t = spec["type"]
    if t == "bool":
        if isinstance(value, str):
            v = value.strip().lower()
            if v in ("1", "true", "on", "yes"):
                return True
            if v in ("0", "false", "off", "no"):
                return False
            raise ValueError(f"{path}: expected on/off, got {value!r}")
        return bool(value)
    if t == "number":
        try:
            x = float(value)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            raise ValueError(f"{path}: expected a number, got {value!r}") from None
        x = max(spec["min"], min(spec["max"], x))
        return int(x) if float(spec["step"]).is_integer() and x.is_integer() else round(x, 4)
    if t == "select":
        opts = spec["options"]
        allowed = [o["value"] for o in options(opts)] if isinstance(opts, str) else opts
        if value not in allowed:
            raise ValueError(f"{path}: {value!r} not in {allowed}")
        return value
    if t == "multi":
        if isinstance(value, str):
            value = [v.strip() for v in value.split(",") if v.strip()]
        if not isinstance(value, list):
            raise ValueError(f"{path}: expected a list")
        return sorted(dict.fromkeys(str(v) for v in value))
    return value


def _clean_patch(patch: dict) -> dict:
    out: dict = {}
    for section, vals in (patch or {}).items():
        if not isinstance(vals, dict):
            raise ValueError(f"section {section!r} must be an object")
        for key, value in vals.items():
            out.setdefault(section, {})[key] = coerce(f"{section}.{key}", value)
    return out


def _write(p: Path, data: dict) -> None:
    data = {s: v for s, v in data.items() if v}
    if not data:
        if p.exists():
            p.unlink()
        return
    p.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


def save_global(patch: dict) -> dict:
    """Merge a {section: {key: value}} patch into settings.json. Values equal to the default are dropped
    (only differences are stored); null resets a key to its default."""
    cur, d = read_global(), defaults()
    for section, vals in _clean_patch(patch).items():
        for key, value in vals.items():
            sec = cur.setdefault(section, {})
            if value is None or value == d[section][key]:
                sec.pop(key, None)
            else:
                sec[key] = value
    _write(GLOBAL_FILE, cur)
    return global_settings()


def save_project(slug: str, patch: dict) -> dict:
    """Per-episode overrides: only changed keys are stored; null removes the override (inherit)."""
    if not (PROJECTS / slug).is_dir():
        raise ValueError(f"unknown project {slug!r}")
    cur = read_project(slug)
    for section, vals in _clean_patch(patch).items():
        for key, value in vals.items():
            sec = cur.setdefault(section, {})
            if value is None:
                sec.pop(key, None)
            else:
                sec[key] = value
    _write(project_file(slug), cur)
    return load(slug)


def reset_global(section: str | None = None) -> dict:
    cur = read_global()
    if section:
        cur.pop(section, None)
    else:
        cur = {}
    _write(GLOBAL_FILE, cur)
    return global_settings()


def reset_project(slug: str, section: str | None = None) -> dict:
    cur = read_project(slug)
    if section:
        cur.pop(section, None)
    else:
        cur = {}
    _write(project_file(slug), cur)
    return load(slug)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ helpers used by the planner / renderer
def template_ok(S: dict, name: str | None) -> bool:
    """May this motion template be used / rendered?"""
    if not name:
        return True
    mo = S["motion"]
    if not mo["enabled"] or name in mo["disabled_templates"]:
        return False
    sw = TEMPLATE_SWITCH.get(name)
    if sw and not mo.get(sw, True):
        return False
    if name == "sticker_pop" and not S["brand"]["stickers"]:
        return False
    if name == "hook_banner" and not S["shorts"]["hook_banner"]:
        return False
    if name == "time_card" and not S["camera"]["cold_open"]:
        return False
    return True


def role_ok(S: dict, roles) -> bool:
    return not (set(roles or []) & set(S["audio"]["disabled_sfx_roles"]))


def mode_ok(S: dict, mode: str | None) -> bool:
    return not mode or mode == "funny" or mode not in S["modes"]["disabled_modes"]


GAG_RX = re.compile(r"^[A-Z0-9']+ X\d+$")


def text_kind(t: dict) -> str:
    """speed | gag | pop: classify an EDL text event so its switch can remove it from existing edits."""
    s = str(t.get("text", ""))
    if t.get("style") == "label" and "SPEED" in s.upper():
        return "speed"
    if GAG_RX.match(s.upper()) and t.get("style") == "minecraft":
        return "gag"
    return "pop"


def apply_render(edl: dict, S: dict, asset_lookup=None) -> list[str]:
    """Render-time kill switches. Mutates `edl` (the in-memory copy the renderer just loaded) and returns notes for
    the render report. Segment removal (cutaways, cards, cold open) happens here, BEFORE spans are built, so all
    timing stays consistent; events anchored to a removed segment are dropped with it."""
    notes: list[str] = []
    L, M, C, Au, Me, Ca, Br, Ed = (S[k] for k in ("looks", "modes", "captions", "audio", "memes", "camera",
                                                  "brand", "editing"))
    count: dict[str, int] = {}

    def note(k: str, n: int = 1):
        count[k] = count.get(k, 0) + n

    # ---- segments that leave the timeline
    removed: set[str] = set()
    keep = []
    for s in edl["segments"]:
        t = s.get("type", "source")
        why = None
        if t == "cutaway" and not Me["cutaways"]:
            why = "meme cutaway"
        elif t == "card" and s.get("template") and not template_ok(S, s["template"]):
            why = f"card {s['template']}"
        elif str(s.get("id", "")).startswith("cold") and not Ca["cold_open"]:
            why = "cold-open segment"
        if why:
            note(f"removed {why}")
            if s.get("id"):
                removed.add(s["id"])
            elif t != "source":
                notes.append(f"removed an id-less {why}: events anchored by output time ('at') after it shift earlier")
            continue
        keep.append(s)
    if not keep:
        notes.append("settings would remove every segment - kept the timeline as is")
        keep, removed = edl["segments"], set()
    edl["segments"] = keep
    first_main = next((s.get("id") for s in keep if not str(s.get("id", "")).startswith("cold")), None)

    def anchored_out(ev: dict) -> bool:
        return ev.get("seg") in removed

    base = edl.get("mode") or "funny"
    if not mode_ok(S, base):
        notes.append(f"base mood {base!r} is switched off - using funny")
        edl["mode"] = base = "funny"

    # ---- per-segment switches
    for s in keep:
        if s.get("mode") and not mode_ok(S, s["mode"]):
            note(f"mood {s['mode']} -> {base}")
            s["mode"] = base
        fx = []
        for e in s.get("effects", []):
            if e == "brighten":
                ok = L["enabled"] and L["brighten_dark"]
            else:
                ok = L["enabled"] and L["effects"] and e not in L["disabled_effects"]
            if ok:
                fx.append(e)
            else:
                note(f"effect {e} off")
        if "effects" in s:
            s["effects"] = fx
        if s.get("zoom"):
            z2 = []
            for z in s["zoom"]:
                if z.get("auto") and not Ca["engage_zooms"]:
                    note("engagement zoom off")
                    continue
                if not z.get("auto") and not Ca["beat_zooms"]:
                    note("beat zoom off")
                    continue
                if Ca["zoom_strength"] != 1.0:
                    z = {**z, "to": round(1 + (z.get("to", 1.3) - 1) * Ca["zoom_strength"], 4)}
                z2.append(z)
            s["zoom"] = z2
        if s.get("shake") and not Ca["shakes"]:
            note("shake off", len(s["shake"]))
            s["shake"] = []
        if s.get("freeze_end") and not Ca["freeze_frames"]:
            note("freeze frame off")
            s.pop("freeze_end")
        if s.get("type") == "cutaway" and not Au["overlay_audio"]:
            s["mute"] = True
        if not Br["avatar"]:
            s.pop("avatar", None)

    # ---- overlays
    ovs = []
    for o in edl.get("overlays", []):
        if anchored_out(o):
            continue
        if o.get("type") == "greenscreen" and not Me["greenscreens"]:
            note("green screen off")
            continue
        if o.get("template") and not template_ok(S, o["template"]):
            note(f"template {o['template']} off")
            continue
        if o.get("template") == "time_card" and not Ca["cold_open"]:
            continue
        if o.get("type") in ("greenscreen", "video") and not Au["overlay_audio"]:
            o = {**o, "audio": False}
        ovs.append(o)
    if not Ca["cold_open"] and removed:
        # the "N MINUTES EARLIER" card + rewind whoosh sit on the first main segment at rel 0
        ovs = [o for o in ovs if not (o.get("template") == "time_card" and o.get("seg") == first_main)]
    if "overlays" in edl:
        edl["overlays"] = ovs

    # ---- text
    texts, gag_keys = [], set()
    for t in edl.get("text", []):
        if anchored_out(t):
            continue
        k = text_kind(t)
        on = {"speed": C["speed_labels"], "gag": C["running_gags"], "pop": C["text_pops"]}[k]
        if not on:
            note(f"{'text pop' if k == 'pop' else k + ' label' if k == 'speed' else 'running-gag counter'} off")
            if k == "gag":
                gag_keys.add((t.get("seg"), t.get("src_at")))
            continue
        texts.append(t)
    if "text" in edl:
        edl["text"] = texts

    # ---- audio
    aud = edl.setdefault("audio", {})
    sfx = []
    for ev in aud.get("sfx", []):
        if anchored_out(ev):
            continue
        if not Au["sfx"]:
            note("sfx off")
            continue
        if gag_keys and ev.get("asset") == "sfx_ui.pop" and (ev.get("seg"), ev.get("src_at")) in gag_keys:
            continue
        a = None
        if asset_lookup and ev.get("asset") and Au["disabled_sfx_roles"]:
            a = asset_lookup(ev["asset"])
        if a and not role_ok(S, a.get("roles")):
            note("sfx type off")
            continue
        if not Ca["cold_open"] and removed and ev.get("seg") == first_main and ev.get("rel") == 0.0:
            continue                                    # the cold open's rewind whoosh
        if Au["sfx_volume_db"]:
            ev = {**ev, "volume_db": round(ev.get("volume_db", 0) + Au["sfx_volume_db"], 2)}
        sfx.append(ev)
    aud["sfx"] = sfx
    music = []
    for m in aud.get("music", []):
        if anchored_out(m):
            continue
        if not Au["music"]:
            note("music bed off")
            continue
        if Au["music_volume_db"]:
            m = {**m, "volume_db": round(m.get("volume_db", 0) + Au["music_volume_db"], 2)}
        if not Au["ducking"]:
            m = {**m, "duck": False}
        music.append(m)
    aud["music"] = music
    if not Au["bleeps"] and aud.get("bleeps"):
        note("bleep off", len(aud["bleeps"]))
        aud["bleeps"] = []
    else:
        aud["bleeps"] = [b for b in aud.get("bleeps", []) if not anchored_out(b)]

    # ---- captions / brand / cutting
    cap = edl.setdefault("captions", {})
    if not C["enabled"]:
        cap["enabled"] = False
    if not C["emphasis"]:
        cap["emphasis_words"] = []
    cap["hide"] = [h for h in cap.get("hide", []) if not anchored_out(h)]
    if not Br["watermark"] and edl.pop("watermark", None):
        note("watermark off")
    if not Br["avatar"] and isinstance(edl.get("avatar"), dict):
        edl["avatar"] = {**edl["avatar"], "always": False}
    if not Ed["cut_guard"]:
        edl["guard_cuts"] = False
    shorts = edl.get("shorts")
    if shorts and removed:
        edl["shorts"] = [x for x in shorts if x.get("from") not in removed and x.get("to") not in removed]

    notes += [f"settings: {k}" + (f" (x{n})" if n > 1 else "") for k, n in sorted(count.items())]
    return notes


def apply_modes(modes: dict, S: dict) -> dict:
    """Mood definitions with switched-off features stripped (used by the renderer and captions)."""
    out = copy.deepcopy(modes)
    for k, m in out.items():
        if k.startswith("_") or not isinstance(m, dict):
            continue
        if not S["looks"]["enabled"] or not S["looks"]["mode_looks"]:
            m["grade"] = ""
        if not S["modes"]["letterbox"]:
            m["letterbox"] = False
        if not S["captions"]["pov_header"]:
            m.pop("header", None)
        if not S["brand"]["avatar"]:
            m["avatar_on"] = False
    return out


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ CLI:  mcs settings show|set|reset
def flat(S: dict) -> dict:
    return {f"{s}.{k}": v for s, sec in S.items() for k, v in sec.items()}


def cli(argv: list[str]) -> None:
    import argparse
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="mcs settings", description="Feature switches (studio/settings.json; "
                                 "per-episode overrides with --slug).")
    sub = ap.add_subparsers(dest="action", required=True)
    p = sub.add_parser("show")
    p.add_argument("--slug")
    p.add_argument("--json", action="store_true")
    p.add_argument("--changed", action="store_true", help="only settings that differ from the defaults")
    p = sub.add_parser("set")
    p.add_argument("key", help="dotted key, e.g. looks.enabled")
    p.add_argument("value", help="on/off, a number, a choice, a comma list, or 'inherit' / 'default'")
    p.add_argument("--slug")
    p = sub.add_parser("reset")
    p.add_argument("section", nargs="?")
    p.add_argument("--slug")
    a = ap.parse_args(argv)
    if a.action == "show":
        S = load(a.slug)
        if a.json:
            print(json.dumps(S, indent=2))
            return
        d = flat(defaults())
        ov = flat({s: v for s, v in read_project(a.slug).items()}) if a.slug else {}
        for k, v in flat(S).items():
            if a.changed and v == d[k]:
                continue
            mark = " (episode)" if k in ov else (" *" if v != d[k] else "")
            print(f"  {k:<34} {json.dumps(v)}{mark}")
        return
    if a.action == "set":
        section, _, key = a.key.partition(".")
        if not _spec(section, key):
            raise SystemExit(f"unknown setting {a.key!r} (see: mcs settings show)")
        raw = a.value
        if raw.lower() in ("inherit", "default", "null", "none") and _spec(section, key)["type"] != "select":
            value = None
        else:
            try:
                value = json.loads(raw)
            except ValueError:
                value = raw
            if _spec(section, key)["type"] == "multi" and isinstance(value, str):
                value = [v for v in value.split(",") if v]
        try:
            S = save_project(a.slug, {section: {key: value}}) if a.slug else save_global({section: {key: value}})
        except ValueError as e:
            raise SystemExit(str(e)) from None
        print(f"{a.key} = {json.dumps(S[section][key])}" + (f"  (episode {a.slug})" if a.slug else ""))
        return
    if a.action == "reset":
        if a.slug:
            reset_project(a.slug, a.section)
        else:
            reset_global(a.section)
        print(f"reset {a.section or 'all'}" + (f" for {a.slug}" if a.slug else ""))

    studio/settings.json                 global settings (only keys that differ from the defaults are needed)
    projects/<slug>/settings.json        per-episode overrides (only changed keys; null = inherit)

    load(slug)  ->  defaults <- settings.json <- parent episode overrides (for shorts) <- episode overrides

SCHEMA is the single source of truth: it defines every setting's default, label, help text, type and where it
applies ("plan" = autoplan/engage/shorts/scaffold decide not to place it, "render" = the renderer also strips it
from an EXISTING edit.json, "both"). The UI renders the schema generically, so adding a setting = one entry here
plus the line of code that reads it.

Render-time switches are applied by `apply_render(edl, S, ...)` when the renderer loads an EDL: the edit.json on
disk is never modified, so turning a switch back on restores the original edit.
"""

def _b(key, label, default, help_, applies, **kw):
    return {"key": key, "label": label, "type": "bool", "default": default, "help": help_, "applies": applies, **kw}


def _n(key, label, default, help_, applies, lo, hi, step, unit="", **kw):
    return {"key": key, "label": label, "type": "number", "default": default, "help": help_, "applies": applies,
            "min": lo, "max": hi, "step": step, "unit": unit, **kw}


def _off(key, label, help_, applies, options, **kw):
    """Multi-select stored as the list of DISABLED items (new items added later default to allowed)."""
    return {"key": key, "label": label, "type": "multi", "invert": True, "default": [], "help": help_,
            "applies": applies, "options": options, **kw}

                   "sticker_pop": None}


def defaults() -> dict:
    return {sec["key"]: {s["key"]: copy.deepcopy(s["default"]) for s in sec["settings"]} for sec in SCHEMA}


def _spec(section: str, key: str) -> dict | None:
    sec = next((s for s in SCHEMA if s["key"] == section), None)
    return next((s for s in sec["settings"] if s["key"] == key), None) if sec else None


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ dynamic option lists
def _read(p: Path, default=None):
    try:
        return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except (OSError, ValueError):
        return default


def options(kind: str) -> list[dict]:
    if kind.startswith("looks"):
        looks = _read(STUDIO / "looks.json", {})
        out = [{"value": k, "label": v.get("label", k), "help": v.get("about", "")}
               for k, v in looks.items() if not k.startswith("_")]
        return ([{"value": "", "label": "Inherit (style.json)"}] if kind.endswith("+inherit") else []) + out
    if kind == "modes":
        modes = _read(STUDIO / "modes.json", {})
        return [{"value": k, "label": v.get("label", k), "color": v.get("color")}
                for k, v in modes.items() if not k.startswith("_") and k != "funny"]   # funny = the fallback
    if kind == "templates":
        out = []
        tdir = STUDIO / "motion" / "templates"
        for d in sorted(tdir.iterdir()) if tdir.exists() else []:
            t = _read(d / "template.json")
            if t is not None:
                out.append({"value": d.name, "label": d.name, "help": t.get("description", ""),
                            "poster": f"/media/studio/motion/previews/{d.name}.jpg"
                            if (STUDIO / "motion" / "previews" / f"{d.name}.jpg").exists() else None})
        return out
    return []


def schema() -> dict:
    """SCHEMA with dynamic option lists resolved, plus the defaults (for the UI)."""
    secs = copy.deepcopy(SCHEMA)
    for sec in secs:
        for s in sec["settings"]:
            s["path"] = f"{sec['key']}.{s['key']}"
            if isinstance(s.get("options"), str):
                s["options"] = options(s["options"])
            elif isinstance(s.get("options"), list) and s["options"] and isinstance(s["options"][0], str):
                s["options"] = [{"value": o, "label": o.replace("_", " ")} for o in s["options"]]
    return {"sections": secs, "defaults": defaults()}


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ load / save
def deep_merge(a: dict, b: dict) -> dict:
    out = dict(a)
    for k, v in (b or {}).items():
        if v is None:                                      # null = inherit
            continue
        out[k] = deep_merge(out[k], v) if isinstance(v, dict) and isinstance(out.get(k), dict) else v
    return out


def project_file(slug: str) -> Path:
    return PROJECTS / slug / "settings.json"


def read_global() -> dict:
    return _read(GLOBAL_FILE, {}) or {}


def read_project(slug: str) -> dict:
    return _read(project_file(slug), {}) or {}


def global_settings() -> dict:
    return deep_merge(defaults(), read_global())


def load(slug: str | None = None) -> dict:
    S = global_settings()
    if slug:
        pj = _read(PROJECTS / slug / "project.json", {}) or {}
        parent = pj.get("parent")
        if parent and parent != slug:                    # shorts inherit their episode's overrides
            S = deep_merge(S, read_project(parent))
        S = deep_merge(S, read_project(slug))
    return S


def coerce(path: str, value):
    """Validate / convert one value against the schema. Raises ValueError."""
    section, _, key = path.partition(".")
    spec = _spec(section, key)
    if not spec:
        raise ValueError(f"unknown setting {path!r}")
    if value is None:
        return None
    t = spec["type"]
    if t == "bool":
        if isinstance(value, str):
            v = value.strip().lower()
            if v in ("1", "true", "on", "yes"):
                return True
            if v in ("0", "false", "off", "no"):
                return False
            raise ValueError(f"{path}: expected on/off, got {value!r}")
        return bool(value)
    if t == "number":
        try:
            x = float(value)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            raise ValueError(f"{path}: expected a number, got {value!r}") from None
        x = max(spec["min"], min(spec["max"], x))
        return int(x) if float(spec["step"]).is_integer() and x.is_integer() else round(x, 4)
    if t == "select":
        opts = spec["options"]
        allowed = [o["value"] for o in options(opts)] if isinstance(opts, str) else opts
        if value not in allowed:
            raise ValueError(f"{path}: {value!r} not in {allowed}")
        return value
    if t == "multi":
        if isinstance(value, str):
            value = [v.strip() for v in value.split(",") if v.strip()]
        if not isinstance(value, list):
            raise ValueError(f"{path}: expected a list")
        return sorted(dict.fromkeys(str(v) for v in value))
    return value


def _clean_patch(patch: dict) -> dict:
    out: dict = {}
    for section, vals in (patch or {}).items():
        if not isinstance(vals, dict):
            raise ValueError(f"section {section!r} must be an object")
        for key, value in vals.items():
            out.setdefault(section, {})[key] = coerce(f"{section}.{key}", value)
    return out


def _write(p: Path, data: dict) -> None:
    data = {s: v for s, v in data.items() if v}
    if not data:
        if p.exists():
            p.unlink()
        return
    p.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


def save_global(patch: dict) -> dict:
    """Merge a {section: {key: value}} patch into settings.json. Values equal to the default are dropped
    (only differences are stored); null resets a key to its default."""
    cur, d = read_global(), defaults()
    for section, vals in _clean_patch(patch).items():
        for key, value in vals.items():
            sec = cur.setdefault(section, {})
            if value is None or value == d[section][key]:
                sec.pop(key, None)
            else:
                sec[key] = value
    _write(GLOBAL_FILE, cur)
    return global_settings()


def save_project(slug: str, patch: dict) -> dict:
    """Per-episode overrides: only changed keys are stored; null removes the override (inherit)."""
    if not (PROJECTS / slug).is_dir():
        raise ValueError(f"unknown project {slug!r}")
    cur = read_project(slug)
    for section, vals in _clean_patch(patch).items():
        for key, value in vals.items():
            sec = cur.setdefault(section, {})
            if value is None:
                sec.pop(key, None)
            else:
                sec[key] = value
    _write(project_file(slug), cur)
    return load(slug)


def reset_global(section: str | None = None) -> dict:
    cur = read_global()
    if section:
        cur.pop(section, None)
    else:
        cur = {}
    _write(GLOBAL_FILE, cur)
    return global_settings()


def reset_project(slug: str, section: str | None = None) -> dict:
    cur = read_project(slug)
    if section:
        cur.pop(section, None)
    else:
        cur = {}
    _write(project_file(slug), cur)
    return load(slug)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ helpers used by the planner / renderer
def template_ok(S: dict, name: str | None) -> bool:
    """May this motion template be used / rendered?"""
    if not name:
        return True
    mo = S["motion"]
    if not mo["enabled"] or name in mo["disabled_templates"]:
        return False
    sw = TEMPLATE_SWITCH.get(name)
    if sw and not mo.get(sw, True):
        return False
    if name == "sticker_pop" and not S["brand"]["stickers"]:
        return False
    if name == "hook_banner" and not S["shorts"]["hook_banner"]:
        return False
    if name == "time_card" and not S["camera"]["cold_open"]:
        return False
    return True


def role_ok(S: dict, roles) -> bool:
    return not (set(roles or []) & set(S["audio"]["disabled_sfx_roles"]))


def mode_ok(S: dict, mode: str | None) -> bool:
    return not mode or mode == "funny" or mode not in S["modes"]["disabled_modes"]


GAG_RX = re.compile(r"^[A-Z0-9']+ X\d+$")


def text_kind(t: dict) -> str:
    """speed | gag | pop: classify an EDL text event so its switch can remove it from existing edits."""
    s = str(t.get("text", ""))
    if t.get("style") == "label" and "SPEED" in s.upper():
        return "speed"
    if GAG_RX.match(s.upper()) and t.get("style") == "minecraft":
        return "gag"
    return "pop"


def apply_render(edl: dict, S: dict, asset_lookup=None) -> list[str]:
    """Render-time kill switches. Mutates `edl` (the in-memory copy the renderer just loaded) and returns notes for
    the render report. Segment removal (cutaways, cards, cold open) happens here, BEFORE spans are built, so all
    timing stays consistent; events anchored to a removed segment are dropped with it."""
    notes: list[str] = []
    L, M, C, Au, Me, Ca, Br, Ed = (S[k] for k in ("looks", "modes", "captions", "audio", "memes", "camera",
                                                  "brand", "editing"))
    count: dict[str, int] = {}

    def note(k: str, n: int = 1):
        count[k] = count.get(k, 0) + n

    # ---- segments that leave the timeline
    removed: set[str] = set()
    keep = []
    for s in edl["segments"]:
        t = s.get("type", "source")
        why = None
        if t == "cutaway" and not Me["cutaways"]:
            why = "meme cutaway"
        elif t == "card" and s.get("template") and not template_ok(S, s["template"]):
            why = f"card {s['template']}"
        elif str(s.get("id", "")).startswith("cold") and not Ca["cold_open"]:
            why = "cold-open segment"
        if why:
            note(f"removed {why}")
            if s.get("id"):
                removed.add(s["id"])
            elif t != "source":
                notes.append(f"removed an id-less {why}: events anchored by output time ('at') after it shift earlier")
            continue
        keep.append(s)
    if not keep:
        notes.append("settings would remove every segment - kept the timeline as is")
        keep, removed = edl["segments"], set()
    edl["segments"] = keep
    first_main = next((s.get("id") for s in keep if not str(s.get("id", "")).startswith("cold")), None)

    def anchored_out(ev: dict) -> bool:
        return ev.get("seg") in removed

    base = edl.get("mode") or "funny"
    if not mode_ok(S, base):
        notes.append(f"base mood {base!r} is switched off - using funny")
        edl["mode"] = base = "funny"

    # ---- per-segment switches
    for s in keep:
        if s.get("mode") and not mode_ok(S, s["mode"]):
            note(f"mood {s['mode']} -> {base}")
            s["mode"] = base
        fx = []
        for e in s.get("effects", []):
            if e == "brighten":
                ok = L["enabled"] and L["brighten_dark"]
            else:
                ok = L["enabled"] and L["effects"] and e not in L["disabled_effects"]
            if ok:
                fx.append(e)
            else:
                note(f"effect {e} off")
        if "effects" in s:
            s["effects"] = fx
        if s.get("zoom"):
            z2 = []
            for z in s["zoom"]:
                if z.get("auto") and not Ca["engage_zooms"]:
                    note("engagement zoom off")
                    continue
                if not z.get("auto") and not Ca["beat_zooms"]:
                    note("beat zoom off")
                    continue
                if Ca["zoom_strength"] != 1.0:
                    z = {**z, "to": round(1 + (z.get("to", 1.3) - 1) * Ca["zoom_strength"], 4)}
                z2.append(z)
            s["zoom"] = z2
        if s.get("shake") and not Ca["shakes"]:
            note("shake off", len(s["shake"]))
            s["shake"] = []
        if s.get("freeze_end") and not Ca["freeze_frames"]:
            note("freeze frame off")
            s.pop("freeze_end")
        if s.get("type") == "cutaway" and not Au["overlay_audio"]:
            s["mute"] = True
        if not Br["avatar"]:
            s.pop("avatar", None)

    # ---- overlays
    ovs = []
    for o in edl.get("overlays", []):
        if anchored_out(o):
            continue
        if o.get("type") == "greenscreen" and not Me["greenscreens"]:
            note("green screen off")
            continue
        if o.get("template") and not template_ok(S, o["template"]):
            note(f"template {o['template']} off")
            continue
        if o.get("template") == "time_card" and not Ca["cold_open"]:
            continue
        if o.get("type") in ("greenscreen", "video") and not Au["overlay_audio"]:
            o = {**o, "audio": False}
        ovs.append(o)
    if not Ca["cold_open"] and removed:
        # the "N MINUTES EARLIER" card + rewind whoosh sit on the first main segment at rel 0
        ovs = [o for o in ovs if not (o.get("template") == "time_card" and o.get("seg") == first_main)]
    if "overlays" in edl:
        edl["overlays"] = ovs

    # ---- text
    texts, gag_keys = [], set()
    for t in edl.get("text", []):
        if anchored_out(t):
            continue
        k = text_kind(t)
        on = {"speed": C["speed_labels"], "gag": C["running_gags"], "pop": C["text_pops"]}[k]
        if not on:
            note(f"{'text pop' if k == 'pop' else k + ' label' if k == 'speed' else 'running-gag counter'} off")
            if k == "gag":
                gag_keys.add((t.get("seg"), t.get("src_at")))
            continue
        texts.append(t)
    if "text" in edl:
        edl["text"] = texts

    # ---- audio
    aud = edl.setdefault("audio", {})
    sfx = []
    for ev in aud.get("sfx", []):
        if anchored_out(ev):
            continue
        if not Au["sfx"]:
            note("sfx off")
            continue
        if gag_keys and ev.get("asset") == "sfx_ui.pop" and (ev.get("seg"), ev.get("src_at")) in gag_keys:
            continue
        a = None
        if asset_lookup and ev.get("asset") and Au["disabled_sfx_roles"]:
            a = asset_lookup(ev["asset"])
        if a and not role_ok(S, a.get("roles")):
            note("sfx type off")
            continue
        if not Ca["cold_open"] and removed and ev.get("seg") == first_main and ev.get("rel") == 0.0:
            continue                                    # the cold open's rewind whoosh
        if Au["sfx_volume_db"]:
            ev = {**ev, "volume_db": round(ev.get("volume_db", 0) + Au["sfx_volume_db"], 2)}
        sfx.append(ev)
    aud["sfx"] = sfx
    music = []
    for m in aud.get("music", []):
        if anchored_out(m):
            continue
        if not Au["music"]:
            note("music bed off")
            continue
        if Au["music_volume_db"]:
            m = {**m, "volume_db": round(m.get("volume_db", 0) + Au["music_volume_db"], 2)}
        if not Au["ducking"]:
            m = {**m, "duck": False}
        music.append(m)
    aud["music"] = music
    if not Au["bleeps"] and aud.get("bleeps"):
        note("bleep off", len(aud["bleeps"]))
        aud["bleeps"] = []
    else:
        aud["bleeps"] = [b for b in aud.get("bleeps", []) if not anchored_out(b)]

    # ---- captions / brand / cutting
    cap = edl.setdefault("captions", {})
    if not C["enabled"]:
        cap["enabled"] = False
    if not C["emphasis"]:
        cap["emphasis_words"] = []
    cap["hide"] = [h for h in cap.get("hide", []) if not anchored_out(h)]
    if not Br["watermark"] and edl.pop("watermark", None):
        note("watermark off")
    if not Br["avatar"] and isinstance(edl.get("avatar"), dict):
        edl["avatar"] = {**edl["avatar"], "always": False}
    if not Ed["cut_guard"]:
        edl["guard_cuts"] = False
    shorts = edl.get("shorts")
    if shorts and removed:
        edl["shorts"] = [x for x in shorts if x.get("from") not in removed and x.get("to") not in removed]

    notes += [f"settings: {k}" + (f" (x{n})" if n > 1 else "") for k, n in sorted(count.items())]
    return notes


def apply_modes(modes: dict, S: dict) -> dict:
    """Mood definitions with switched-off features stripped (used by the renderer and captions)."""
    out = copy.deepcopy(modes)
    for k, m in out.items():
        if k.startswith("_") or not isinstance(m, dict):
            continue
        if not S["looks"]["enabled"] or not S["looks"]["mode_looks"]:
            m["grade"] = ""
        if not S["modes"]["letterbox"]:
            m["letterbox"] = False
        if not S["captions"]["pov_header"]:
            m.pop("header", None)
        if not S["brand"]["avatar"]:
            m["avatar_on"] = False
    return out


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ CLI:  mcs settings show|set|reset
def flat(S: dict) -> dict:
    return {f"{s}.{k}": v for s, sec in S.items() for k, v in sec.items()}


def cli(argv: list[str]) -> None:
    import argparse
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="mcs settings", description="Feature switches (studio/settings.json; "
                                 "per-episode overrides with --slug).")
    sub = ap.add_subparsers(dest="action", required=True)
    p = sub.add_parser("show")
    p.add_argument("--slug")
    p.add_argument("--json", action="store_true")
    p.add_argument("--changed", action="store_true", help="only settings that differ from the defaults")
    p = sub.add_parser("set")
    p.add_argument("key", help="dotted key, e.g. looks.enabled")
    p.add_argument("value", help="on/off, a number, a choice, a comma list, or 'inherit' / 'default'")
    p.add_argument("--slug")
    p = sub.add_parser("reset")
    p.add_argument("section", nargs="?")
    p.add_argument("--slug")
    a = ap.parse_args(argv)
    if a.action == "show":
        S = load(a.slug)
        if a.json:
            print(json.dumps(S, indent=2))
            return
        d = flat(defaults())
        ov = flat({s: v for s, v in read_project(a.slug).items()}) if a.slug else {}
        for k, v in flat(S).items():
            if a.changed and v == d[k]:
                continue
            mark = " (episode)" if k in ov else (" *" if v != d[k] else "")
            print(f"  {k:<34} {json.dumps(v)}{mark}")
        return
    if a.action == "set":
        section, _, key = a.key.partition(".")
        if not _spec(section, key):
            raise SystemExit(f"unknown setting {a.key!r} (see: mcs settings show)")
        raw = a.value
        if raw.lower() in ("inherit", "default", "null", "none") and _spec(section, key)["type"] != "select":
            value = None
        else:
            try:
                value = json.loads(raw)
            except ValueError:
                value = raw
            if _spec(section, key)["type"] == "multi" and isinstance(value, str):
                value = [v for v in value.split(",") if v]
        try:
            S = save_project(a.slug, {section: {key: value}}) if a.slug else save_global({section: {key: value}})
        except ValueError as e:
            raise SystemExit(str(e)) from None
        print(f"{a.key} = {json.dumps(S[section][key])}" + (f"  (episode {a.slug})" if a.slug else ""))
        return
    if a.action == "reset":
        if a.slug:
            reset_project(a.slug, a.section)
