input.message:
The settings system is built and every toggle I tested works end to end. Most switches also apply to an existing edit.json at render time, without re-planning, and edit.json on disk is never changed. **The :8765 server needs a restart**: until then the new `/api/settings*` endpoints don't exist and the new Settings page has nothing to load. The UI files are served from disk with no-cache, so they need no restart. All settings (global and per-episode) are back at defaults now.

## Settings: 10 sections, 61 keys (all defaults reproduce current behaviour)
- **looks** ("Filters & colour", has a master switch): `enabled` (off = no look, no mood grade, no effects, no brighten), `default_look`, `disabled_looks` (a switched-off look falls back to default → clean → none), `intensity` 0–1 (blends the graded picture with the original), `mode_looks`, `brighten_dark`, `effects`, `disabled_effects` (flash/bw/deepfry/vignette/sepia/invert).
- **modes**: `auto_story_modes`, `disabled_modes` (a disabled mood falls back to the base mood, or funny; funny itself can't be disabled), `letterbox`.
- **captions**: `enabled`, `emphasis`, `pov_header`, `text_pops`, `running_gags`, `speed_labels`.
- **audio**: `sfx`, `disabled_sfx_roles` (11 roles), `sfx_volume_db`, `max_sfx_per_min` (14), `favorites_only`, `music`, `music_volume_db`, `ducking`, `overlay_audio` (meme and green-screen sound), `bleeps`, `speech_gate`.
- **memes**: `cutaways`, `max_cutaways_per_min` (1.5), `greenscreens`, `max_greenscreens_per_min` (1.2), `disabled_placements` (fullscreen/corner), `favorites_only`.
- **camera**: `beat_zooms`, `engage_zooms`, `zoom_strength`, `shakes`, `freeze_frames`, `speed_montage`, `cold_open`.
- **motion** (has a master switch): `enabled`, `title_card`, `time_card`, `subscribe_cta`, `advancement_toast`, `location_tag`, `boss_bar`, `disabled_templates` (all 40 templates on disk; you said 41, but 40 exist).
- **brand**: `watermark`, `avatar`, `stickers` (the Crodie sticker_pop reactions; one key, not duplicated under motion).
- **editing**: `cut_guard`, `cut_fades`, `dead_air_removal`, `max_gap_s` (0.55).
- **shorts**: `enabled`, `count`, `min_s`, `max_s`, `hook_banner`.

Lists are stored as the *disabled* items, so templates, looks or moods added later are on by default. A per-episode `projects/<slug>/settings.json` stores only the changed keys, with `null` meaning inherit. Shorts also inherit their parent episode's overrides.

## Plan-time vs render-time
- **Plan-time only:** story moods, max SFX/memes/green screens per minute, favourites-only, green-screen placements, speed montages, dead-air removal and longest pause, and shorts count/length/on-off. These need a re-plan to take effect.
- **Render-time only:** looks (master, allowed, default, strength, mood grades), effects, letterbox, POV header, volume nudges, ducking, meme/green-screen audio, bleeps, speech gate, avatar, cut guard, cut fades, zoom strength. These apply to existing edits on the next render.
- **Both** (the planner stops placing it and the renderer strips it from existing edits): everything else.
- **How the render side works:** `settings.apply_render()` runs when the renderer loads the EDL, before `build_spans`.
  - Turning off meme cutaways, a template card or the cold open removes those segments from the timeline cleanly. Events anchored to a removed segment go with it, and the cold open's "EARLIER" card and rewind whoosh are dropped too.
  - What was removed is listed in `render_report.json` under `"settings"` and printed to the console.
- **Render cache:** a segment's hash now changes whenever a switch changes its pixels or audio (resolved look plus mood-grade chain, strength, cut fades). At default settings nothing extra is added to the hash, so existing caches stay valid.

## Proof on `settings-test` (copy of auto-dig; auto-dig itself untouched)
- **Looks, SFX, captions, watermark, title card, green screens and cutaways off:**
  - Duration went from 105.77 s to 101.30 s, exactly the two removed cutaways.
  - Frame comparison: no captions, no logo, no title-card animation, ungraded colour (mean saturation 14.1 → 10.9).
  - The audio graph has no SFX inputs. A gain-matched diff against the baseline shows differences only at the SFX times (1.2, 4.07, 20.3, ~29, 34 s); everywhere else the two mixes match to about -31 dB.
- **Strength 0.5, shader/vivid disallowed, cold open, music, engagement zooms, text pops and ducking off:** the blend filter renders correctly, saturation came out halfway (13.0), the video starts directly on s001, and there is no music or sidechain in the audio graph.
- **Unit checks:** disabling "sad" left 0 sad segments, disabling hit/stinger left 0 disallowed SFX, and zoom strength 0.5 halved the zooms.
- **Autoplan with stickers, memes, green screens, boss_bar and voice_line/stinger off:** 0 stickers, 0 cutaways, 0 of those SFX roles (the default plan had 1 sticker, 2 cutaways and 12 such SFX). A second run with motion, captions, watermark, zooms, music, SFX, story moods, freeze frames and brighten off gave a plan with none of them.
- **Shorts:** the count came from settings and the hook banner was off.
- **Endpoints and UI:** every endpoint passed in TestClient (validation errors return 400, values are clamped). In the browser, on a throwaway server on :8799, I checked the master switch greying its children, the template chip grid with posters and its search, autosave with the toast, and the episode tab's Inherit/On/Off override. No console errors, and `node --check` passes.

## Files
- **New:** `studio/mcstudio/settings.py` (schema, load/save, render filter, CLI) and `studio/settings.json` (holds the full global settings for easy hand-editing).
- **Changed:**
  - `mcstudio/render.py` and `mcstudio/autoplan.py`: surgical edits, each marked `# [settings]`.
  - `mcstudio/shorts.py`, `mcstudio/pipeline.py`, `mcstudio/scaffold.py`, `mcstudio/cli.py`, `mcstudio/server.py`.
  - `ui/app.js`, `ui/index.html`, `ui/style.css`.
- **Behaviour change:** the server's auto stages and the CLI no longer hard-code `--shorts 3`; the count comes from settings (default 3).

## Endpoints
- `GET /api/settings/schema`
- `GET /api/settings`, `PATCH /api/settings`
- `POST /api/settings/reset` (body `{section?}`)
- `GET /api/projects/{slug}/settings`, `PATCH /api/projects/{slug}/settings`
- `POST /api/projects/{slug}/settings/reset`

CLI: `mcs settings show [--slug] [--changed]`, `mcs settings set <section.key> <value|inherit> [--slug]`, `mcs settings reset [section] [--slug]`.

## UI
- **Settings page** (#/settings, in the sidebar after Brand & modes): collapsible section cards with a master switch per section, switches, sliders, selects and chip lists, a plan/render badge and help text on every setting, a search across all settings, reset per section and reset all, and debounced autosave with a toast.
- **Episode "Settings" tab:** the same layout in override mode, showing the inherited value. "Re-plan with these settings" runs the existing autoplan stage; for a hand-made edit it asks first and the old edit.json is kept in history/. "Re-render preview" runs the existing preview stage.

## What couldn't be made toggleable at render time
- **Speed montages:** turning one into a normal-speed segment would change the cut, so this is plan-time only.
- **SFX, meme and green-screen caps, favourites-only, placements:** these are choices made when picking assets, so they are plan-time only.
- **Beat zooms vs hand-placed zooms:** an existing edit doesn't record which is which, so at render time `beat_zooms` covers every non-auto zoom.
- **Text events:** in existing edits these are told apart by heuristics. "x4 SPEED" labels are recognised by the label style, running-gag counters by the "WORD xN" pattern in the minecraft style, and everything else counts as a text pop.
- **Cut guard:** it doesn't take the cold-open removal into account, but the result still renders correctly.

`settings-test` is left in place with its overrides cleared (edit.json is a fresh copy of auto-dig's; preview outputs and comparison frames are in its `out/`). Delete it whenever you like.
